title: Aeon Trespass: Odyssey
subtitle: Colossal campaign of exploration, titan crafting, and mythic boss battles in a godless Antiquity
tagline: Awaken the Titans, command the Argo, and defy the Primordial doom
loreSummary: You are Argonauts aboard the giant ironclad city-ship Argo. In the wake of an apocalyptic cataclysm that slew the Olympian gods, you must pilot giant bio-mechanical Titans, discover forgotten technologies, and fight monstrous Primordials across an unraveling ancient Greece.
keyFeatures: Escalating tactical boss combat with dynamic AI, wound decks, and titan death-spiral mechanics
Extensive voyage phase with deep strategic map exploration, research trees, and city-ship management
Choice Matrix system where pivotal narrative decisions branch across multi-cycle campaigns
Epic campaign trilogy totaling 250+ hours across Cycles I, II, and III

ato_core_trilogy.name: Full Core Trilogy (Cycles I–III)
ato_core_trilogy.description: The complete 3-cycle core saga: Truth of the Labyrinth, Abysswatchers, and Pitiless of the Sun.

ato_cycle_1.name: Cycle I: Truth of the Labyrinth
ato_cycle_1.description: The standalone first cycle covering the voyage to Crete, labyrinth mystery, and initial Primordial clashes.

ato_speedrun.name: Focused Critical Path
ato_speedrun.description: Streamlined narrative progression through mandatory story milestones and Primordials with minimal side exploration.

ato_completionist.name: Grand Chronicler (Cycles I–III + Mnestis)
ato_completionist.description: All 3 cycles, all optional hunts, Mnestis Theatre battle arena challenges, and complete Titan tech trees.
